conventions.convention: Whitney stratifications require both (a) and the moving-lower-point form of (b), connected smooth algebraic frontier strata, and tangent/secant comparisons in chosen local affine embeddings.

Tube compositions are required only on named domains where defined; shrinking is allowed. Local properness over compact base slices and local boundedness of controlled lifts are separate requirements.
The compatible control-data construction uses squared bundle radii; the ordinary normal-tube estimate initially uses unsquared distance.
Analytic properness gives properness of the whole inverse image over a target stratum, not of each nonclosed source stratum.
A finite triangulation of noncompact X means a homeomorphism |K| minus |D| to X for finite complexes D contained in K; it does not mean X is a finite compact realization.
Finite simplicial mapping-cylinder constructions permit vertex identifications and boundary subdivision; they do not extend arbitrary fixed boundary triangulations without subdivision.
The open cone has radial interval [0,1), and the cone on an empty link is a single apex.
Constructibility along complex strata requires actual derived coefficient transport; real simplex dimensions do not replace complex stratum dimensions in perversity.
The geometric existence and derived-sheaf results assume AC; the explicit simplicial cylinder and star constructions are choice-free.

load_bearing.statement: Assume AC. On any separated finite-type complex variety, bounded algebraically constructible objects have bounded finite ordinary and compact-support cohomology, ordinary derived Hom and bounded constructible internal Hom, with coefficient-extension compatibility, by these models locally and finite affine-open descent globally. No simultaneous stratification of an arbitrary cyclic diagram respecting all marked supports is asserted.

Assume AC. For quasi-projective complex X and a bounded analytic field-sheaf complex with finite-rank locally constant cohomology on a finite complex algebraic stratification, there are compatible complex Whitney refinements and finite deleted-boundary triangulation models respecting finitely many prescribed supports and inclusions. Actual ordinary and compact-support cohomology, derived Hom, internal derived Hom and local support cohomology have bounded finite-dimensional models; internal Hom is complex-algebraically constructible, local models vary locally constantly along the complex strata, and the models commute with field extension.

Assume AC. A compact finite controlled Whitney-stratified subset of a smooth ambient space admits a finite triangulation of dimension at most the largest real stratum dimension, compatible with every stratum closure and any prescribed union of strata. The construction may make the finitely many normal link-bundle projections between triangulated compact stratum cores piecewise linear; it does not make an arbitrary algebraic map globally simplicial.

Assume AC. A reduced quasi-projective complex variety with a given finite smooth complex algebraic Whitney stratification admits compatible tube data and stratum-preserving local products B^(2 dim_C R) times the open cone on a compact finitely Whitney-stratified real semialgebraic normal link. Links are locally constant in stratified homeomorphism type along R. Proper stratified algebraic submersions have whole-fiber local trivializations; local submersions have source-neighborhood products.

Assume AC. For a locally closed finite Whitney-stratified W and a smooth ambient map restricting to a submersion on every stratum, every smooth base field admits stratumwise smooth locally bounded controlled lifts after shrinking. Their ODE solutions give jointly continuous stratum-preserving local flows and inverses, source-local products, and whole-fiber bundle trivializations when the map is proper.

Assume AC. A locally closed finite smooth Whitney frontier-stratified subset of Euclidean space admits squared-radius tube control data with defined incident compositions satisfying projection and radius control identities, disjoint incomparable tubes, incident pair submersions and local properness over compact lower-stratum slices. A smooth ambient map submersive on every stratum can additionally be preserved.

Assume AC. One morphism of reduced quasi-projective complex varieties admits finite smooth complex algebraic Whitney (a),(b) frontier stratifications respecting finitely many prescribed closed or locally closed algebraic subsets, with each source stratum mapping surjectively and smoothly onto one target stratum. A prescribed finite algebraic stratification may be refined. Properness concerns the whole inverse image of a target stratum.

Assume AC. A compact finite smooth Whitney frontier-stratified Euclidean subset admits normalized tubes and continuous stratum-preserving radial projections, smooth on strata, with incident commutation, radius preservation, projection equivariance and semigroup identities on the retained domains. Punctured tubes have product collars, and adjoining the stratum gives the corresponding open mapping cylinder.

A simplicial map of finite complexes, allowing vertex identifications, has a finite triangulated topological mapping cylinder of dimension at most max(dim K + 1, dim L), fixing both boundary copies, with PL retraction and simultaneous subcylinder compatibility after subdivision.

Assume AC. Near each point of a lower stratum in a finite smooth Whitney-stratified Euclidean subset, an ordinary normal tube can be shrunk so its projection/distance pair is submersive on every incident upper stratum and has smooth stratumwise differential right inverses locally uniformly bounded near that lower stratum. This supplies one-stratum bounded tangential lifts and radial lifts of norm at most C times the distance; simultaneous controls and continuous stratified flows are not asserted.

alerts.finding: F3 says, “Smooth algebraic maps admit compatible finite smooth stratifications of source and target,” citing thm-complex-algebraic-varieties-and-maps-admit-compatible-finite-stratifications. The consumer Statement allows separated finite-type complex varieties, whereas the cited supplier Statement explicitly assumes reduced quasi-projective source and target. Proof 1.1 correctly refers to the supplier being available “on affine charts”; qualify F3 accordingly or supply the globalization. This is a citation-domain wording mismatch, not a refutation of smooth perverse exactness.

seams_checked.note: The Whitney definition retains connected analytic frontier strata. The finite-poset supplier is used for diagram models; it is not treated as an analytic sheaf comparison. Constructibility remains a condition on bounded finite-rank cohomology sheaves.

Generic Whitney regularity uses the normalized-arc supplier with a positive-dimensional irreducible fibre and nonempty open. Stratification existence uses the explicit connectedness/closure comparison. The cochain arguments retain the actual incidence essential-image, support and product-unit comparisons; finite affine-open descent uses the locally split topological Čech clause.

The compact triangulation proof constructs face-compatible bundle charts in steps 9.1–11.1 and the closed projection-preserving collar diagram and protected buffer in step 19.1 before invoking relative bundle fitting. Singular collapsed ends are handled topologically rather than assigned the supplier's whole-star smooth contract.

The Morse and noncharacteristic consumers use controlled products for explicitly transverse local or compact proper families, and distinguish real wall spaces from algebraic strata. Their coefficient transport is separately reconstructed through finite incidence models rather than inferred from an unstratified homeomorphism.

The proper-weights theorem's F6 and Proof 2.1 use deleted-boundary triangulations on affine charts, then simplicial-star cone products to construct a contractible-open basis. They do not apply the quasi-projective triangulation theorem globally to an arbitrary proper variety.

The finite conical/cochain uses in duality and six-operation proofs retain finite affine-open descent and fixed-space models. However, the smooth-pullback lemma's F3 omits the stratification supplier's quasi-projectivity hypothesis while its own Statement permits general separated finite-type varieties. Proof 1.1 uses affine charts; the localized citation should be stated explicitly. Routed in alerts.

The acyclic-fibre consumer explicitly assumes the finite local-product setting and bounded constructible pushforward outputs. Stiefel and Ext consumers use the general separated finite-type cochain wrapper through finite affine-open descent and assert degreewise finiteness, not finite total equivariant cohomology.

The semisimplicity corollary applies the cohomology bound to compact projective fibres inside the flag variety, obtaining constant-coefficient amplitude [0,2f]. It explicitly does not infer a uniform all-sheaf bound from that constant-coefficient calculation or a globally simplicial incidence morphism.
